note: Which GT7 circuits and layouts can produce rain. GT7 broadcasts no weather channel in any packet format, so this is the one strategy input that cannot be measured or checked from the stream. It is the DEFAULT answer for the event page's 'rain possible' question; a driver answer overrides it, and an in-game confirmation is recorded under `confirmed` and outranks everything.
source: Gran Turismo Wiki, Gran Turismo 7/Track List — https://gran-turismo.fandom.com/wiki/Gran_Turismo_7/Track_List
why: It is complete rather than partial (41 tracks, 84 layouts, including everything added since 2022), it is per LAYOUT rather than per track, and it agrees with the two independent August 2022 community lists on all 11 circuits those covered. Layout granularity is the part the older lists got wrong: Dragon Trail Gardens rains and Seaside does not; Tokyo Expressway Central and East rain and South does not.
completeness: This list is complete for the 41 tracks it covers, so a track present here with no rain layout genuinely cannot rain. A track absent from it entirely — a circuit added after this was read — is UNKNOWN, not dry.
